_comment: License identifiers adjudicated by the latest full license-check record in this directory, each with the reason it is allowed; consumed by scripts/check_licenses.py. An identifier the SBOM no longer contains is stale and fails the gate (--prune removes it). Refresh with a fresh record (--update), then write a reason for every new identifier.
